title: The Present and Imperfect Subjunctive
subtitle: amem / amārem. The marker vowels.
objectives: Form imperfect subjunctive from infinitive + personal endings.
Understand subjunctive as the mood of possibility, wish, or uncertainty.

sections.heading: The subjunctive mood
sections.body:
The subjunctive expresses possibility, wish, purpose, doubt, or hypothetical action.

Present subjunctive:
  1st: amem, amēs, amet, amēmus, amētis, ament (marker: -e-)
  2nd/3rd/4th: moneam, regam, audiam (marker: -ā-, -ā-, -iā-)

Imperfect subjunctive: infinitive + -m, -s, -t, -mus, -tis, -nt:
  amārem, amārēs, amāret, amārēmus, amārētis, amārent

Cicero writes: Utinam vīverem! — Would that I were living!

items.answer: laudem, laudēs, laudet, laudēmus, laudētis, laudent
regerem, regerēs, regeret, regerēmus, regerētis, regerent
